scientific_integrity: The statement of new contribution is limited to sharp minimum and uniqueness; the witness groups and mere existence are prior-covered by a 2023 general suspension theorem.
scientific_limitations: All labeled connected simple graphs on at most seven vertices are exhaustively checked over F2; larger graphs and integral homology of other graphs are outside scope. The witness integral groups follow separately by an elementary collapse. No independent audit.
title: The pentagonal bipyramid is the unique minimal zero-Euler bold-homology graph
